part.text: {"scores":[{"criterion":"stakes","value":3,"ref":"card:limits","reason":"Outcomes could guide whether to scale computed screening, but peptide fragments, contact proxies, and absent cell-level transcytosis make the choice indirect."},{"criterion":"lever","value":3,"ref":"plan:compute_axis.levels","reason":"The 8–32 replica range spans only 4×, failing 10×; its ≥0.15 AUC separation exceeds the 0.10 noise tolerance, and compute, inputs, and hardware are controlled."},{"criterion":"verifiable","value":5,"ref":"plan:anchor","reason":"AUC uses experimental BBB, domain, and pH-release labels independent of MD; before MD, setup reproduces the published LRP6 assignment with a four-of-five-model tolerance."},{"criterion":"open","value":5,"ref":"card:left_open","reason":"The cited work establishes structural and assay precedents but does not test computed pH-resolved lifetimes across variants; the card explicitly preserves this gap."},{"criterion":"reshape","value":1,"ref":"card:method","reason":"The only parallelism is independent ten-nanosecond replicas, one per GPU; each trajectory remains sequential, so no step-after-step dependency is removed."},{"criterion":"baseline","value":5,"ref":"plan:phases[p_baselines]","reason":"GROMACS uses GPU offload and OpenMP; sequential and replica arms share V100s, ensemble occupancy is checked within 0.15, and p_baselines times both."}],"decides_by":"p_score","decides_by_reason":"p_score is the first phase that computes AUCs at 8, 16, and 32, applies split-half noise checks, and evaluates the pH-ratio rule."}
